fatal_failures: the exact public static ProcessDay(EvergreenTradeState, LocalDate, List) entry point or required public support types are absent
notice does not permanently freeze the repurchase date
the coincident re-rate and month-end date emits zero or multiple interest settlements
the pre-collision bucket is repriced, the collision day is included in the old settlement, or any interest is compounded or paid twice
the implementation passes monetary or rate arithmetic through double or float, edits generated model code, or ignores the supplied holiday calendar

criteria.description: Expose the exact state-machine contract with typed state, events, settlements, and trigger reasons.
checks: Compile and invoke benchmark.evergreen.EvergreenRepoLifecycle.ProcessDay directly.
Return a non-null DayResult whose state and immutable settlement list use the required public record and enum types.

criteria.description: Maintain the crawling tenor across business days, weekends, a bank holiday, and month-end.
checks: Before notice, residual maturity is exactly the CDM notice-period multiplier on every processed date.
Business dates replace the termination leaf with date plus tenor business days; weekends and 25 August 2025 leave it unchanged.
Business-day counting excludes the start, includes the result, and uses the supplied holiday set.

criteria.description: Freeze on notice and expose the intended LCR residual-maturity transition.
checks: Notice on 31 July 2025 locks the date at 19 September 2025 with the supplied 25 August holiday.
Later business and non-business calls never crawl the date again.
The contractual business-day residual is 35 on notice day, while LCR uses calendar days: 31 on 19 August and first 30 on 20 August.

criteria.description: Handle a re-rate on the scheduled month-end payment date as one atomic settlement.
checks: 4 August 2025 emits exactly one GBP 700.00 settlement with RERATE and MONTH_END reasons.
The incoming bucket through 3 August is paid at 3.65% and reset once before the re-rate.
The returned rate is 7.30% and its fresh bucket contains GBP 200.00 for 4 August without compounding.

criteria.description: Use the pinned CDM termination and evergreen paths while preserving unrelated model content.
checks: Read the tenor from terminationProvision.evergreenProvision.noticePeriod rather than hard-coding 35; a 10-business-day fixture crawls by 10.
Read and update only terminationDate.adjustableDate.unadjustedDate through generated 7.0.0 getters/builders.
Preserve trade state, histories, product content, metadata, date-adjustment content, and the original immutable input.

criteria.description: Accrue daily ACT/365 simple interest exactly and settle it as CDM Money.
checks: Accrue every non-final calendar day, including weekends and holidays, against the unchanged principal.
Use BigDecimal scale-18 HALF_EVEN division, accumulate without compounding, and round only settlement Money to two decimals HALF_EVEN.
Preserve the principal currency and never use double or float.

criteria.description: Implement standalone month-end and final-repurchase settlement behavior.
checks: The second business day strictly after a calendar month-end settles once even without a re-rate.
The final repurchase date is accrual-end-exclusive: it settles through the prior day once, resets, marks terminated, and rejects later processing.
Any coincident trigger set produces one settlement with the complete reason union.

criteria.description: Reject malformed temporal transitions and inputs without changing state.
checks: Require exactly the next calendar date and reject processing after termination.
Reject weekend/holiday notices, repeated notice, duplicate event types, null/unknown events, blank party, and negative re-rates.
Reject missing or unsupported CDM paths, invalid calendars, non-positive principal, and negative incoming rates or accrual.

criteria.description: Keep inputs and result collections stable and prove the dangerous sequence boundaries.
checks: Do not mutate CDM values, application records, caller event lists, or the caller holiday set.
Authored tests invoke the exact public method sequentially and directly assert freeze, LCR crossing, and exactly-once collision behavior.
Do not wire whole-object qualification or generated lifecycle event infrastructure that the contract does not invoke.
